name: sagemaker-mldlc-workflow
description: An AI-coding-driven ML development workflow for Amazon SageMaker: a planner that composes a run from named stages, plus one skill per stage that can also be called on its own. Covers traditional machine learning and deep learning - tabular regression and classification, time-series forecasting, and framework or custom-container training - and deliberately not large-model fine-tuning. Data processing, training, batch transform and real-time inference are each invocable alone or composed into a SageMaker Pipeline. The AWS China partition is the verified baseline: every capability claim carries a China verdict.
